updates.closure_rationale: Logical value independence is distinguished from representation sharing and from language-enforced ownership. A defined single-threaded raw-alias demonstration changes shared scalar backing after cloning, deliberately bypassing the API and falsifying automatic independence. Rust Cow borrowed/owned and to_mut passages are accurately bounded comparisons, not equivalence to this reference-counted C store. Actual retained OwCow clone/write/drop implement scalar sharing, unique no-allocation mutation, transactional detach and last-owner release. The required resource variant owns three separately allocated resource handles per raw control. It clones into an unpublished stage, includes the failing callback partial owner in reverse cleanup, then changes the current pointer only after complete success. One POSIX mutex protects snapshot selection and retain, reads, writes, release and reclamation; no raw mutable borrow escapes. Six C17 profiles execute six anchors, six compiled controls and six compiling-stub rejections. The independent Python logical-list and separate sharing/accounting oracle checks3275legal histories up to5operations over3owners. Tests cover raw failure, each typed allocation failure, each post-acquisition partial-clone failure, unique allocation counts, shared detach, invalid indices, four-slot fullness, stale tokens, final serial retirement and close/drain. Actual retained OW_MUTANT7/17 reject shared mutation and premature failed-detach decrement. Cost samples distinguish zero unique clone calls from3detach clones; actual object imports, stack, sizes and incremental build observations are retained. The owned-resource and concurrent-reader delayed variant is implemented. Two actual pthread readers retain800snapshots while one writer makes500attempts; each snapshot reads an unchanged value twice around a yield. Real finite allocator exhaustion may refuse a detach without altering old owners, and no success/refusal distribution is assumed. An independently held old snapshot survives the workload; all callers join before final release/destroy. Separate GCC/Clang C17 TSan executions are diagnostic-clean for these observed histories. This does not prove arbitrary interleavings, fairness or unsupported callback cancellation/nonlocal exit. Unaided delayed learner performance remains unassessed. Bounded author support only.
